parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true, residing in Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerAnalyticsTests.swift at lines 293 and 310 respectively. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.7) between capturesPauseEvent and capturesStopEvent is expected in a test suite: each test method intentionally exercises a distinct audio-player event (pause vs. stop) and must remain a separate, named test case for clear failure attribution. Merging or extracting them into a shared helper would obscure which event scenario failed and couples test semantics in a way that reduces diagnostic value.
